release: Media Library Scan & Disk I/O Optimization
name: Media Library Scan & Disk I/O Optimization
changes: Cache Automation media analysis by path and file size/mtime/file identity and persist it across scans/restarts, without storing media contents.
Re-use quality, fingerprint and codec/HDR traits for unchanged files without opening their contents.
Inspect each changed TV/movie candidate once for codec/HDR metadata and reuse it for quality cutoffs and display.
Preserve real directory traversal to detect new, moved and missing episodes; invalidate analysis when file metadata changes.
Keep bounded rebuildable cache storage and preserve Smart Import/quality/episode matching.
regression_guards: Preserve v3.7.18 release identity and v3.7.17 original filename behavior.
Preserve v3.7.16 video console suppression, v3.7.15 media/queue behavior, v3.7.14 Completed history and v3.7.13 gallery.
Ensure warm scans do not re-read media contents; changed same-size files revalidate; cache corruption is recoverable.
preserved: No changes to NNTP, SABnzbd 5.1.2, SABCTools 9.6.3, image/video thumbnails, Downloads, Smart Import or Metadata Server.
Automated scans still enumerate library directories to discover additions/deletions.
